field.name: prompt
field.div:
Generate an image for this product:
product_name: product_tmpl_id > name
product_image: image_1024
product_description: product_tmpl_id > description
product_description_sale: product_tmpl_id > description_sale
product_type: product_tmpl_id > type

field.name: prompt
field.div:
1. If an image is provided (image_1024): - Ask the user what changes they would like to make. - Provide a few concise example options inspired by the image (e.g., lighting, time of day, motion blur, color temperature, background, etc.). - The response must be **a list of 3 recommended changes**. - Keep it **very concise and direct**.
2. If no image is provided: - Ask the user to provide an image. - Ask them to mention the enhancements they would like.
Example (image provided): What changes would you like to make to this image? - time of day. - motion blur amount. - background style. Example (no image): Please provide an image and tell me what enhancement you would like to see in the image.
